criteriaResults.description: Must check and enforce 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio for text
criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly requires verifying that all text maintains a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

criteriaResults.description: Must include focus-visible styles and keyboard navigation for all interactive elements
criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly mandates checking for visible `:focus-visible` states and functional keyboard navigation for all interactive elements.

criteriaResults.description: Must use semantic HTML elements (nav, main, article, section) not div soup
criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly instructs the assistant to reject 'div soup' and enforce the use of semantic HTML elements like nav, main, article, and section.

criteriaResults.description: Must include ARIA labels on icon-only buttons, modals, and form fields
criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly requires `aria-label` for icon-only buttons, modals, and form inputs lacking visible labels.

criteriaResults.description: Must handle images responsively (srcset, lazy loading, alt text)
criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly enforces checking for `alt` text, responsive attributes (`srcset`, `sizes`), and `loading="lazy"` for images.

criteriaResults.description: Must include accessible form validation with error messages linked to fields
criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly requires ensuring error messages are programmatically linked to inputs using `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid`.

criteriaResults.description: Must respect prefers-reduced-motion for animations
criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly mandates wrapping all animations in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.
